integrity: The source algorithm, residual definitions, proximal-gradient decrease inequality, enlarged global stepsize range, and local superlinear statements were independently inspected. The proof derives the affine normal residual and exact candidate geometry directly; an exact-rational verifier checks a noncommuting two-dimensional instance and scalar sharpness witnesses.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to convex quadratic composites with positive-definite total Hessian and exact scaled normal-Newton directions. It does not extend the general Dennis--Moré theorem beyond its stated assumptions, and it does not classify practical quasi-Newton approximations.
title: Factor-two full-step robustness of PANOC-lite on convex quadratic composites
